title: Documents
description: Files people added here. {product} answers questions from them and cites the document and page. Whoever may see this place's data may read them.
addHint: PDF, Word (.docx), text or Markdown, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture, up to {mb} MB each. Scanned pages and pictures are read by a model.
dropHint: Drop to add them to the documents
dataClassHint: Which models may receive the text: a stricter class sends it to fewer.
dataClassManagers: A class less strict than {class} is for those who manage this place.
emptyBody: Add a policy, a contract, a report or a scanned letter, then ask about it.
columns.name: Name
fromImages: {count, plural, one {# read from its image} other {# read from their images}}
name: Name
classHint: Its text is embedded again, through a model allowed this class. Ask's model gets its passages only if it's allowed the class too.
deleteDescription: Its file and its text go, and Ask no longer answers from it. This can't be undone.
uploadAnnounce: {total, plural, one {{done} of # file added} other {{done} of # files added}}
leaveDescription: {count, plural, one {A file is still being added. If you leave, it isn't.} other {# files are still being added. If you leave, they aren't.}}
viewer.textHint: What Ask reads and cites, page by page.
viewer.fromImage: Read from the page's image by a model: it may differ from what's written.
viewer.noPreview: A {kind} file isn't shown here: download it to see it as written.
viewer.wordPages: A Word file's pages are its page breaks, and may differ from the pages Word shows.
viewer.emptyPage: There's no text on this page.
viewer.notReady: This document isn't read yet ({status}): its pages come once it is.
viewer.notFound: There's no such document, or you may not read it.
